hero.title: 13 Years of Crafting the
hero.subtitle: From a vision in 2013 to a globally recognized application development company. This is our story.

paragraphs.text: Founded in 2013 as a division of Mobisoft Labs, CRE Innovations emerged from a simple belief: great software should be beautiful, performant, and intelligent.
India-based with global application users, our team of young, highly motivated professionals spans two locations and four disciplines.
100+ applications delivered. Partners include Facebook, Google, Aviary, and Instagram.

items.title: Mission
items.text: To build technically superior, AI-infused mobile and web applications that delight users and exceed expectations — one exceptional product at a time.

items.title: Vision
items.text: To be recognized globally as the benchmark for mobile application and game development, where innovation is standard and excellence is the minimum.
